object_description: two height-graded building volumes forming a cohesive complex
design_condition: Two freely placed volumes form a spacious complex with the existing school, using differentiated heights and single-storey bases to transition pleasantly to the pedestrian level while creating varied outdoor areas.

positive.statement: The large building volumes are integrated well into the small-scale context by taking up the landscape qualities of the district.

position.rationale: Two distinct volumes and graded heights are visible across the top and elevation views.

positive.statement: Differentiated height grading and single-storey base buildings create a pleasant transition to the pedestrian level.

position.rationale: Broad low-level bands are clearly visible beneath taller upper volumes.

positive.statement: The independent architectural expression integrates the existing school and builds a strong identity as a cohesive public facility.

position.rationale: The sampled geometry reads as an integrated complex of differentiated masses.

positive.statement: The central room is well lit and forms the heart of the school, with classrooms and group rooms arranged around it.

position.rationale: A central interior room is not exposed, so it is anchored within the central building region.

positive.statement: Flexible room dividers create surprising spatial constellations that support various educational concepts.

position.rationale: Interior partitions are unseen; the marker approximates a classroom zone within the visible mass.

positive.statement: The outdoor areas offer a wide range of activities.

position.rationale: Open ground-level regions occur around and between the sampled building volumes.

positive.statement: The allocation and design of pedestrian routes, deliveries and parking facilities are well separated for lessons and events.

position.target: pedestrian routes, deliveries and parking facilities
position.rationale: Site circulation is not individually distinguishable; the marker uses a plausible peripheral ground zone.

positive.statement: The foyer and stage area extend the hall into an attractive space continuum open to its surroundings on both sides.

position.rationale: Interior foyer and stage are not visible, approximated in the broad lower building volume.

positive.statement: The two buildings have efficient supporting structures, low space requirements, robust materialization and a lean energy concept, supporting good economic efficiency.

position.target: efficient supporting structures and lean energy concept
position.rationale: Economic and sustainability judgment concerns the whole complex without a locatable feature.

negative.statement: The kindergarten outdoor areas are only partially visible from the rooms and are limited in size in some places.

position.rationale: Kindergarten grounds are not identifiable; a constrained low-level peripheral area is used.

negative.statement: The connection of the equipment room to the gymnasium via the corridor must be questioned from an operational perspective.

position.rationale: The internal corridor connection is absent from the exterior sample and approximated within the lower mass.

negative.statement: The dimensions of the stage access must be checked.

position.rationale: Stage access is internal and indistinguishable, so it is placed near the likely hall zone.

negative.statement: The sometimes high glass proportion and aspects of the interior design should be optimized in the interests of economy.

position.rationale: The comment concerns visible envelope surfaces, anchored on a representative front-facing facade region.
